name: XDAY
author: Gam3r2234
description: Time the green orb click when your UFO icon is near the end of the platform at 11% and then quickly do two fast clicks to fall between the invisible spikes and the platform, don't click for a bit to fall into the invisible teleport portal to bring you above the level at 12%. Maintain a constant position above the level after being teleported until the end from there.
